assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for a photorealistic medieval TOP-DOWN strategy game. STRICT ZENITH CAMERA, 90 DEGREE ELEVATION: looking VERTICALLY DOWN at a castle's ROOF PLAN. Optical axis perpendicular to ground. NOT ISOMETRIC, NOT OBLIQUE, NOT THREE-QUARTER VIEW. The ground plan is seen without foreshortening. Building edges and roof ridges align with the horizontal and vertical image axes. Show ROOFS, the TOPS of curtain walls and towers, and the open courtyard floor; ZERO visible vertical facade height, NO FRONT ELEVATION, NO doors/windows on vertical walls. Round towers are circles seen from above. Photorealistic rough grey stone, aged timber, dark slate roofs, subtle moss; neutral muted northern medieval palette. Gentle light from upper left gives roof surfaces relief, not a side-view silhouette. True transparent alpha around the whole compact object, centered, 10 percent empty padding on all sides. No square ground tile, no horizon, no text, no heraldic banners, no UI. Roof-plan game asset, not a photographed miniature. Subject: A small early fortified lord's manor: one rectangular stone keep with a dark pitched slate roof seen only from above, a modest timber palisade ring enclosing a small courtyard, one small wooden store shed and a narrow gate opening at the screen bottom. A simple first development stage, much less complex than a full stone castle. The keep roof dominates, the palisade is just a thin timber perimeter viewed from above.
